verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Session Replay docs say teams can 'quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off.' The marketing site describes saving replay playlists 'based on events or properties,' which implies replays can be filtered by event-defined user groups. The snippets never explicitly describe a one-click jump from a funnel drop-off step to the affected users' replays, and error events are not mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a direct funnel-step-to-replay drill-down, error-event-to-replay linkage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
